description: 80-dps first-principles evaluation of higher-l spin-orbit Pauli fiber multiplicities (2j+1), 3D harmonic-oscillator cumulative closures, Carbon-12 (Z=N=6) 1p_{3/2} subshell closure, universal Mayer-Jensen magic closures M_K = (K+1)(K+2)(K+3)/3 + (2K+4) in {28, 50, 82, 126, 184}, quadratic Fermi/Pauli symmetry energy E_sym propto (N-Z)^2/A, and spin-orbit shell corrections across 14 benchmark nuclei (4He to 238U). Zero fitting, zero float64.
q0AnchorReason: Evaluates parameter-free QOU nuclear spin-orbit shell closures, oscillator spacings, and quadratic Pauli symmetry energies across both the proton and muon q0 pins (plus the 2-term Borromean root q_2t) to verify cross-anchor stability of the Mayer-Jensen and symmetry-energy closure hierarchy.
